reuse.why: Changes the rule inside the existing shared getScheduledAmount and keeps using getApproxNumberThreshold for the tolerance.

duplication.why: No logic is duplicated; the rule is simplified to Math.min and amount minus threshold in the one helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts where every consumer already gets the expected amount from.

scope.why: Only the helper, its tests and the existing release note are updated.

maintainability.why: The new rule is shorter and clearer, named 'lowest', and all callers inherit it automatically.

bypasses_abstraction.where: The change is made inside getScheduledAmount; no caller computes the expected amount on its own.

disguised_duplication.where: None; logic is edited in place in the shared helper.
